item.title: Show HN: A context-aware permission guard for Claude Code
item.description:
📝 We needed something like --dangerously-skip-permissions that doesn’t nuke your untracked files, exfiltrate your keys, or install malware. What it guards nah is a PreToolUse hook that intercepts every tool call before it executes: Tool What nah checks Bash Structural command classification — action type, pipe composition, shell unwrapping Read Sensitive path detection (~/. Read targets sensitive path: ~/.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/manuelschipper/nah/
